subject: school building renovation
source: The town's secondary school will be renovated over the next three years. The project includes new science laboratories, a library and better insulation. Classes will continue during the works, using temporary classrooms. The total cost is estimated at eighteen million, mostly covered by regional funds. Parents have been invited to an information evening next week.
translation: L'école secondaire de la ville sera rénovée au cours des trois prochaines années. Le projet comprend de nouveaux laboratoires de sciences, une bibliothèque et une meilleure isolation. Les cours se poursuivront pendant les travaux, dans des classes provisoires. Le coût total est estimé à dix-huit millions, pris en charge en grande partie par des fonds régionaux. Les parents sont invités à une soirée d'information la semaine prochaine.
paraphrase: Over the coming three years, the local secondary school is to be refurbished. New science labs, a library and improved insulation are all part of the plan. Lessons will go on throughout the works in temporary classrooms. Most of the estimated eighteen million cost will be paid by the region. An information evening for parents will take place next week.
independent_same: Teachers at the secondary school have launched a project to reduce screen time among pupils. Phones must now be kept in lockers during the school day. Staff report calmer breaks and more conversation between students. Some parents worry about being unable to reach their children. The school will review the rule at the end of the year.
independent_other: Le nombre d'élèves inscrits dans l'enseignement technique augmente pour la troisième année consécutive. Les filières liées à la construction et à l'énergie sont particulièrement demandées. Les écoles manquent cependant d'équipements modernes. Les fédérations patronales proposent de prêter des machines. Un accord de collaboration sera signé au printemps.

subject: rise in bicycle thefts
source: Bicycle thefts have risen by thirty percent in the city centre this year, police figures show. Most thefts take place near the railway station and the university. Police advise cyclists to use two locks and register their bikes. A secure parking facility for five hundred bikes will open at the station next spring. Officers have also increased patrols in the evening.
translation: Les vols de vélos ont augmenté de trente pour cent dans le centre-ville cette année, selon les chiffres de la police. La plupart des vols ont lieu près de la gare et de l'université. La police conseille aux cyclistes d'utiliser deux cadenas et de faire enregistrer leur vélo. Un parking sécurisé de cinq cents places ouvrira à la gare au printemps prochain. Les agents ont aussi renforcé les patrouilles en soirée.
paraphrase: According to police statistics, thirty percent more bikes have been stolen in the city centre this year. The station and the university area are where most of the thefts happen. Officers recommend that cyclists lock their bikes with two locks and get them registered. Next spring, a secure car park with room for five hundred bicycles will open at the station. Evening patrols have also been stepped up.
independent_same: A new bike-sharing scheme with electric bicycles will be launched in the city in May. Users will be able to unlock bikes with a smartphone app. Stations will be located near tram stops and car parks. The first thirty minutes of each ride will be free for subscribers. The operator plans to add cargo bikes later.
independent_other: Une association propose des cours gratuits de vélo pour adultes qui n'ont jamais appris à rouler. Les participants apprennent d'abord à garder l'équilibre sur un terrain fermé. Ils découvrent ensuite les règles de circulation en ville. La plupart sont des femmes qui souhaitent gagner en autonomie. Les inscriptions sont ouvertes jusqu'à la fin du mois.

subject: local newspaper closure
source: The town's weekly newspaper will publish its final edition at the end of the month after ninety years. Its owners cite falling advertising revenue and rising printing costs. Eight journalists and staff will lose their jobs. Readers have expressed their sadness on social media. A group of former employees is considering launching an online news site.
translation: L'hebdomadaire de la ville publiera sa dernière édition à la fin du mois, après quatre-vingt-dix ans d'existence. Ses propriétaires invoquent la baisse des recettes publicitaires et la hausse des coûts d'impression. Huit journalistes et employés perdront leur emploi. Les lecteurs ont exprimé leur tristesse sur les réseaux sociaux. Un groupe d'anciens salariés envisage de lancer un site d'information en ligne.
paraphrase: After ninety years, the local weekly will print its last issue at the end of this month. The owners blame shrinking advertising income and higher printing costs. Eight people, journalists and other staff, will be made redundant. On social media, readers have shared how sad they are. Some former employees are thinking about starting a news website.
independent_same: A national survey finds that trust in local news remains higher than trust in national media. Readers value coverage of council meetings, schools and local sport. However, fewer young people pay for news subscriptions. Publishers are experimenting with newsletters and podcasts. Some are asking for public support for local journalism.
independent_other: Une radio locale associative fête ses quarante ans ce week-end. Elle est animée par une cinquantaine de bénévoles de tous âges. Ses émissions mêlent musique, débats et informations de quartier. Une journée portes ouvertes permettra au public de visiter les studios. La radio cherche de nouveaux animateurs.

subject: drought and water restrictions
source: Water restrictions have been introduced in twelve municipalities after weeks without significant rain. Watering gardens and washing cars are now banned during the day. Farmers can still irrigate crops at night under strict limits. The water company says reservoirs are at their lowest level for a decade. Inspectors will check compliance and may issue fines.
translation: Des restrictions d'eau ont été instaurées dans douze communes après des semaines sans pluie significative. L'arrosage des jardins et le lavage des voitures sont désormais interdits en journée. Les agriculteurs peuvent encore irriguer leurs cultures la nuit, dans des limites strictes. La société des eaux indique que les réservoirs sont à leur plus bas niveau depuis dix ans. Des inspecteurs contrôleront le respect des règles et pourront dresser des amendes.
paraphrase: Twelve municipalities now face water restrictions following weeks with almost no rain. During daytime it is forbidden to water gardens or wash cars. Under tight limits, farmers are still allowed to irrigate at night. Reservoir levels are the lowest in ten years, according to the water company. Inspectors will make sure the rules are respected and can impose fines.
independent_same: Farmers are switching to drought-resistant crops as summers become drier. Sorghum and certain varieties of wheat need less water than maize. Agricultural schools have started teaching new irrigation techniques. Some farmers are building small ponds to store winter rain. The regional government offers grants for water-saving equipment.
independent_other: Les nappes phréatiques se sont bien rechargées grâce à un hiver particulièrement pluvieux. Les hydrologues restent toutefois prudents pour l'été prochain. Ils rappellent que les sols compactés absorbent mal l'eau de pluie. Des communes plantent des haies pour freiner le ruissellement. Un réseau de surveillance supplémentaire sera installé.

subject: new cancer screening programme
source: A free bowel cancer screening programme will be offered to everyone aged fifty to seventy-four. Eligible residents will receive a home test kit by post. The test is simple and takes only a few minutes. Doctors say early detection greatly improves the chances of recovery. Health authorities hope at least half of those invited will take part.
translation: Un programme gratuit de dépistage du cancer colorectal sera proposé à toutes les personnes âgées de cinquante à soixante-quatorze ans. Les habitants concernés recevront un kit de test par la poste. Le test est simple et ne prend que quelques minutes. Selon les médecins, un dépistage précoce améliore fortement les chances de guérison. Les autorités sanitaires espèrent qu'au moins la moitié des personnes invitées y participeront.
paraphrase: Everyone between fifty and seventy-four will be offered free screening for bowel cancer. Those who qualify will get a test kit delivered to their home. Doing the test is easy and only takes a few minutes. Finding the disease early makes recovery much more likely, doctors explain. Health officials would like at least half of the people invited to respond.
independent_same: A new cancer centre will open at the university hospital next year. It will bring together diagnosis, treatment and support services in one building. Patients will be able to see several specialists on the same day. A garden and a quiet room have been designed for families. The centre was partly funded by public donations.
independent_other: Une campagne de sensibilisation invite les jeunes à se protéger du soleil. Les dermatologues constatent une hausse des cancers de la peau. Ils recommandent de porter un chapeau et d'utiliser une crème solaire adaptée. Des distributeurs gratuits de crème seront installés dans les parcs. La campagne vise surtout les adolescents.

subject: housing construction plan
source: The city council has approved a plan to build two thousand new homes over ten years. A third of the homes will be affordable rental housing. The project will reuse former industrial land near the canal. Residents' groups want guarantees about green spaces and school places. Construction of the first phase should start in eighteen months.
translation: Le conseil communal a approuvé un plan de construction de deux mille nouveaux logements sur dix ans. Un tiers de ces logements seront des locations à prix abordable. Le projet réutilisera d'anciens terrains industriels près du canal. Les comités de riverains demandent des garanties sur les espaces verts et les places dans les écoles. La construction de la première phase devrait commencer dans dix-huit mois.
paraphrase: A plan for two thousand new homes over the next decade has been approved by the city council. One in three will be affordable homes for rent. The development will take place on old industrial sites along the canal. Local residents' associations are asking for guarantees on parks and school capacity. Work on the first phase is expected to begin in a year and a half.
independent_same: House prices in the city have risen faster than wages for the fifth year in a row. First-time buyers now need almost ten years of savings for a deposit. Estate agents report strong demand for small flats near the station. Some young families are moving to surrounding villages. Economists expect prices to stabilise next year.
independent_other: Une commune rurale transforme une ancienne école en logements pour personnes âgées. Les appartements seront adaptés aux personnes à mobilité réduite. Une salle commune permettra d'organiser des activités. Le projet vise à permettre aux aînés de rester dans leur village. Les premiers résidents s'installeront l'an prochain.

subject: airport night flights
source: The regional airport has been given permission to increase night flights by twenty percent. Local residents say the noise already disturbs their sleep. The airport argues that cargo flights are essential for jobs in the region. Under the new permit, the noisiest aircraft will be banned between midnight and six. Residents' groups plan to challenge the decision in court.
translation: L'aéroport régional a obtenu l'autorisation d'augmenter de vingt pour cent les vols de nuit. Les riverains affirment que le bruit perturbe déjà leur sommeil. L'aéroport fait valoir que les vols de fret sont essentiels pour l'emploi dans la région. Selon le nouveau permis, les avions les plus bruyants seront interdits entre minuit et six heures. Les comités de riverains comptent contester la décision en justice.
paraphrase: Night flights at the regional airport may now rise by a fifth after permission was granted. People living nearby complain that the noise already keeps them awake. Cargo traffic is vital for local employment, the airport says. The new permit bans the loudest aircraft from midnight to six in the morning. Residents' associations intend to take the decision to court.
independent_same: The regional airport will build a new terminal to handle growing passenger numbers. The terminal will be powered partly by solar panels. Passengers will have direct access to a new train station. Construction is expected to take four years. Airlines have welcomed the announcement.
independent_other: Une étude médicale suggère que le bruit nocturne augmente le risque de troubles cardiovasculaires. Les chercheurs ont suivi plusieurs milliers d'habitants vivant près de grands axes. L'effet serait plus marqué chez les personnes âgées. Les auteurs recommandent de mieux isoler les logements exposés. Des aides à l'isolation acoustique existent dans certaines régions.

subject: volunteer firefighters shortage
source: Rural fire stations are struggling to recruit volunteer firefighters. Several stations can no longer guarantee a full crew during working hours. Fire chiefs say fewer young people live and work in the same village. The government plans to offer tax benefits to employers who release volunteers. A recruitment campaign will start next month.
translation: Les casernes de pompiers rurales peinent à recruter des pompiers volontaires. Plusieurs postes ne peuvent plus garantir une équipe complète pendant les heures de travail. Selon les chefs de corps, de moins en moins de jeunes vivent et travaillent dans le même village. Le gouvernement prévoit d'accorder des avantages fiscaux aux employeurs qui libèrent des volontaires. Une campagne de recrutement débutera le mois prochain.
paraphrase: Recruiting volunteer firefighters has become difficult for fire stations in the countryside. During the working day, several of them can no longer be sure of having a full team. Fire chiefs explain that fewer young people both live and work in their village. Employers who let volunteers leave work for call-outs could get tax advantages under a government plan. Next month, a campaign to attract recruits will begin.
independent_same: Firefighters in the region attended a record number of calls during the summer. Many were wildfires in dry fields and forests. Crews worked long shifts in high temperatures. The fire service is asking residents not to light barbecues near vegetation. New water tankers have been ordered.
independent_other: Une caserne de pompiers a organisé une journée de formation aux premiers secours pour les habitants. Plus de cent personnes ont appris les gestes qui sauvent. Les participants se sont exercés au massage cardiaque sur des mannequins. Les pompiers rappellent l'importance de connaître l'emplacement des défibrillateurs. D'autres sessions sont prévues à l'automne.

subject: minimum wage increase
source: The national minimum wage will rise by four percent in January. The government says the increase will help workers cope with higher living costs. Business organisations warn that small companies may hire fewer people. Trade unions argue the rise does not go far enough. Around three hundred thousand workers are expected to benefit.
translation: Le salaire minimum national augmentera de quatre pour cent en janvier. Le gouvernement affirme que cette hausse aidera les travailleurs à faire face à l'augmentation du coût de la vie. Les organisations patronales avertissent que les petites entreprises pourraient embaucher moins. Les syndicats estiment que l'augmentation est insuffisante. Environ trois cent mille travailleurs devraient en bénéficier.
paraphrase: In January, the national minimum wage is going up by four percent. According to the government, the rise will help employees deal with the higher cost of living. Employers' organisations caution that small firms might take on fewer staff. For the unions, the increase is too modest. Some three hundred thousand employees should see their pay go up.
independent_same: Inflation slowed for the third month in a row, the national statistics office reports. Food prices rose less quickly, while energy prices fell. Rents, however, continued to increase. Economists expect inflation to return to normal levels by next year. The central bank will meet next week to discuss interest rates.
independent_other: De plus en plus d'entreprises testent la semaine de quatre jours. Les salariés travaillent le même nombre d'heures, réparties sur quatre journées. Les premiers retours font état d'une meilleure motivation et de moins d'absences. Certains secteurs, comme le commerce, jugent le modèle difficile à appliquer. Une étude nationale sera publiée l'an prochain.

subject: zoo welcomes rare birth
source: The city zoo has announced the birth of a rare red panda cub. The cub was born in July but has only now left its nest box. Keepers say mother and baby are in good health. The zoo takes part in a European breeding programme for the endangered species. Visitors may catch a glimpse of the cub in the early morning.
translation: Le zoo de la ville a annoncé la naissance d'un rare petit panda roux. Le petit est né en juillet, mais n'a quitté son nichoir que récemment. Les soigneurs indiquent que la mère et le bébé sont en bonne santé. Le zoo participe à un programme européen d'élevage pour cette espèce menacée. Les visiteurs pourront peut-être apercevoir le petit tôt le matin.
paraphrase: A rare red panda cub has been born at the city zoo, the zoo announced. Although it arrived in July, the cub has only just come out of its nest box. Both mother and young are healthy, according to the keepers. The endangered species is part of a European breeding programme in which the zoo participates. Early in the morning, visitors might be able to spot the cub.
independent_same: The city zoo is building a new enclosure for its elephants. The area will be three times larger and include a pool. The project follows criticism from animal welfare groups. Construction will cost around eight million. The elephants will move to the new enclosure next summer.
independent_other: Un refuge pour animaux lance un appel à l'adoption de chats après un été très chargé. Plus de deux cents chats attendent une famille. Les bénévoles constatent de nombreux abandons pendant les vacances. Le refuge rappelle l'importance de la stérilisation. Des journées d'adoption sont organisées chaque samedi.
